digest.component_or_area: LLM usage log / PydanticAIRunner failure path
propositions: A raising LLM call leaves run() via the except spine before record() executes, so no usage row is written for a call that may have burned input tokens.
Because failed calls never reach the usage log, summarize() under-reports actual spend and per-step attribution is incomplete for exactly the runs that failed.

A failed call should write a usage row carrying the same identifying fields (op, step, model_class, model, provider) plus known token counters, distinguishable from a successful call via an explicit outcome marker.
Telemetry on the failure path must not convert or swallow the provider exception, preserving the original error and its cause.
A call that fails and is then retried must be recorded so the same spend is not counted twice as delivered work.
The fix adds record_failure() in runner.py's except block and an explicit outcome key on every row, keeping the no-op-when-unset and summarize()-folding guarantees intact.
